discord.summary: No official Discord server was found for Boomboxheads v2. The project's official public surfaces (mint page, GitHub repositories, and token metadata) contain no Discord link; community chat historically happened in the M3 hackerspace Discord, which is not an official collection Discord.

evidence.note: Official mint page contains only a 'Mint page has moved to Zora!' note; no Discord link anywhere on the page.
Official v2 assets repository README contains no Discord link or invite.
Official generator tool repository README contains no Discord link or invite.

x.summary: Official X/Twitter account of the Boomboxheads project: https://x.com/boomboxheads. Token metadata external_url points to it and the project's announcements reference it.

evidence.note: Official boom-tools README sample ERC metadata sets external_url to https://twitter.com/boomboxheads for every token.
Project X post referenced from the official Boomboxheads v2 writeup (hackmd.io/@XR/boomboxheads-v2).
Legends assets repository README instructs owners to tag @boomboxheads on Twitter.

project_status.summary: Boomboxheads v2 minted in April 2023 (420/420 capped supply, all minted). The official mint page is static ('Mint page has moved to Zora!'), and the last dated project writeup is from 2024-03-07. No ongoing activity was observed.

evidence.note: Official mint page is static and defers to Zora; no current campaign, roadmap, or news.
Project writeup last dated 2024-03-07; describes the completed mint and post-mint experiments.
Release date 2023-04-17; capped supply 420 minted; only 5 recorded sales with no ongoing mint.
